score_comment_short: The customer portfolio and review routines are specific, while renewal results remain unstated.
score_comment_long: The Northwind role names 32 B2B SaaS accounts and $2.4M in annual recurring revenue. The objective is broad, and the resume doesn't say what changed after the renewal-risk reviews. Naming your target role and bringing the portfolio detail forward would make the story easier to follow.
score_plain: The resume gives a reviewer useful customer success details to work with. A more specific objective would help them understand which role you're pursuing.
first_impression: Your current title points to customer success, but the objective could apply to almost any role. A customer success manager is often read for portfolio ownership and renewals, so a more specific target would help frame the rest of the page.
biggest_gap_example: "Results-driven, detail-oriented professional seeking a challenging role where I can utilize my skills." doesn't name a target role, leaving a reviewer to infer it from your experience.
summary: Managing 32 B2B SaaS accounts with $2.4M in annual recurring revenue gives a reviewer a useful picture of your customer portfolio. Your current work combines renewal-risk reviews with conversations involving customer leadership teams, supporting a customer success manager read. The earlier logistics role adds client reporting and customer contact. Are you pursuing another customer success role? The broad objective leaves that direction to the reader.
strengths: The account count and annual recurring revenue figure make the Northwind portfolio tangible.
Monthly renewal-risk reviews show a recurring process across the portfolio.
Quarterly business reviews with customer leadership teams identify the audience for an important part of your work.
gaps: The objective doesn't specify the role you want, so it doesn't connect your experience to a clear next step.
The renewal-risk reviews don't explain how you identified or addressed risks, or what happened afterward.
The business-review bullet doesn't say which customer priorities or account decisions you discussed.
